title: Saving New Customer on a term deactivated meanwhile is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Choose a name for the new customer, customer A.
  • Start with your browser showing the Customers page and user B's browser showing the Credit Terms page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type the name of customer A in Customer Name.
  3. Choose term A in Credit Terms.
  4. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  5. In user B's browser, click "Deactivate".
  6. In your browser, click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows term A.

Step 4:

  • The menu opens.

Step 5:

  • User B sees "term A deactivated".

Step 6:

  • The app's error alert shows "Pick an active credit term." The New Customer window stays open and the customer is not created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Story 5, Error Handling: “If the chosen term was deactivated or deleted after the form opened, Save on New Customer is refused and the app's standard error alert shows "Pick an active credit term." The form stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New Customer term no longer active (server) | "Pick an active credit term." | Standard error alert, form stays open”
